title: nan
authors: Padhy R.P.; Sa P.K.; Narducci F.; Bisogni C.; Bakshi S.
key_contribution: Presents a monocular vision-aided depth measurement method with Kalman filtering for collision-free UAV navigation in unknown GPS-denied environments, achieving 88.6% accuracy in indoor and outdoor tests.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Hybrid_Classical_Learning to ensure precise positioning.
